title: 力德科技战略总监：产能扩张进行时，定增计划助力人形机器人业务
speaker: Angle Jagan

segments.en: Now, since you mentioned you're seeing a ton of demand in a lot of orders. How are you guys doing in terms of capacity?
segments.zh: 既然你提到需求旺盛、订单很多，那你们的产能情况如何？

segments.en: Are you okay with capacity? Are you looking to increase Capix, for example, and I just had a very quick glance at your cash flows and it does see you guys are investing in as far as operations are concerned.
segments.zh: 产能够用吗？是否在考虑增加资本开支？我快速看了下你们的现金流，似乎正在加大运营投入。

segments.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah. We always expand our capacity.
segments.zh: 是的，我们一直在扩张产能。

segments.en: Actually, the company has a private placement plan this year, but the application is still under the review by China Stocks Regulatory Commission
segments.zh: 实际上，公司今年有定增计划，但申请还在证监会审核中。

segments.en: and once it is approved, we've got to raise a large amount of money, so some of them will be invested in the human robotics industry especially to expand our production capacity.
segments.zh: 一旦获批，我们将募集大量资金，其中一部分将投入人形机器人产业，特别是扩大产能。
